      "observations": [
        "Entire historical patch read. FolderMigrator retains the old DB in mDB rather than a setup-local reference and clears cached headers/closes it when Run exhausts enumeration. That cleanup occurs before the async insert request is queued, not only after final SQL completion.",
        "The checked SetupAndRun can Complete(true) before dispatch when its initial enumerator has no elements or HasMoreElements fails. Complete itself resolves/rejects the promise and releases/rolls back a savepoint; it does not call the explicit ClearCachedHdrs/Close pair. The added cleanup therefore must not be described as an all-exit cleanup guarantee. No empty-summary leak, error-injection result or general destructor behavior was reproduced.",
        "Close(false) and ClearCachedHdrs return values are not checked at this site. No tests changed or ran. Reuse the existing migration-close fact and add this exact cleanup-branch boundary as a separate scoped clarification.",
        "Read full Bug1965746 description/comments0–12, updates/footer and D255599 creation-to-final timeline/footer; zero submitted inlines or summary edits. The umbrella remains ASSIGNED with leave-open. Early folder reconciliation, header field ingestion, summary migration and later thread remapping are separate stages, not evidence that this one leak repair completes migration or connects its removed front end.",
        "Comment11 and the assigned review summary report that database shutdown and cached-header clearing were missing and leaked; landing12 is the distinct repair. Actual historical/current source adds ClearCachedHdrs and Close(false) on normal enumeration exhaustion before asynchronous SQL inserts. The already-inspected immediate-empty/enumerator-error SetupAndRun path calls Complete without that explicit close sequence. Sparse acceptance and a failed/ongoing-build landing do not establish all-path cleanup or measured leak freedom. No migration, leak experiment, linked job, runtime or fresh build ran."
